opportunities.title: Diseñador/arquitecto para casa en San Luis Talpa, El Salvador -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco un diseñador o arquitecto para acompañar las decisiones de diseño de Casa Zalamar, una casa en construcción en San Luis Talpa, La Paz, El Salvador. Ya tenemos un modelo 3D preciso, selecciones por ambiente y un paquete eléctrico de referencia. Pueden ver una vista previa del proyecto en https://public.smp-properties.com. El trabajo es de diseño y distribución (layout) solamente: proponer, revisar y recomendar. El dimensionamiento, el cumplimiento normativo y la firma o liberación de las instalaciones corresponden al electricista o ingeniero del propietario. Todo el trabajo se realiza en un espacio de trabajo compartido (zalamar.smp-properties.com), con herramientas de IA. Los entregables se envían como cambios (commits / pull requests) al repositorio Git del proyecto. Yo me encargo de la puesta en marcha y de la capacitación, sin costo; no hace falta experiencia previa en Git. Me gustaría empezar por horas o con un primer alcance pequeño y fijo: un plano de iluminación, apagadores y circuitos (qué luces van con qué apagador), porque la losa aún no se ha colado. Si el trabajo fluye bien, hay más alcances de diseño. Habrá visitas ocasionales a obra en San Luis Talpa. Adjunto un PDF con la solicitud de propuesta completa (menú de alcances, forma de trabajo y condiciones). En su propuesta, por favor incluyan: - Su tarifa por hora en USD (y, si gustan, un precio fijo para el plano de iluminación, apagadores y circuitos). - Portafolio: 2 o 3 proyectos relevantes con planos o imágenes, idealmente al menos uno de iluminación o apagadores. - Una o dos referencias de clientes anteriores que podamos contactar por la plataforma. - Dónde están ubicados, el tiempo de viaje hasta San Luis Talpa y su disponibilidad para comenzar. Saludos, Steve --- English: I'm looking for a designer or architect for Casa Zalamar, a house under construction in San Luis Talpa, La Paz, El Salvador. You can preview the project at https://public.smp-properties.com. The work is design and layout only: no engineering sizing, code compliance, or sign-off. We'll work in my shared AI workspace and Git repository; I'll handle setup and training at no cost, and you don't need prior Git experience. I'd like to start hourly or with a small fixed first task: a lighting, switch and circuit plan (which lights go with which switch). There will be occasional site visits in San Luis Talpa. Please see the attached RFP PDF. In your proposal, include your hourly rate in USD (and optionally a fixed price for the lighting, switch and circuit plan), 2 or 3 relevant portfolio projects with plans or images (ideally one lighting or switch layout), one or two past-client references we can contact through the platform, and your location, travel time to San Luis Talpa, and availability. Thanks, Steve

Review all supplied content and recommend a logical brochure structure/page plan. Present 2 initial design directions for the cover and key interior pages. opportunities.title: Meta Ads Expert Needed for SaaS – Facebook & Instagram Campaigns That Convert
opportunities.description: Project Type: Initial setup + ongoing optimization Industry: SaaS / AI / Digital Marketing Website: https://www.repget.com Project Description We are looking for an experienced Facebook & Instagram Ads specialist to create, launch, manage, and optimize high-converting advertising campaigns for RepGet, an AI-powered SaaS platform focused on SEO, content creation, social media automation, and online visibility. Our primary goal is to acquire paying customers at a profitable cost, not just generate clicks, impressions, or followers. We want someone who understands SaaS customer acquisition, subscription-based businesses, conversion tracking, and performance marketing. What We Need Campaign Strategy: Research our target audience, competitors, market opportunities, and the best advertising approaches for SaaS subscriptions. Complete Meta Ads Setup: Configure and optimize campaigns through Meta Ads Manager, including Facebook and Instagram placements. Conversion Tracking: Set up or verify Meta Pixel, Conversions API, conversion events, and retargeting audiences. Audience Research: Identify high-intent audiences, including business owners, marketers, agencies, startups, and potential users of competing SaaS solutions. Ad Creatives & Copywriting: Develop compelling advertising angles, headlines, visuals, and conversion-focused messaging. A/B Testing: Test different creatives, audiences, offers, and campaign structures. Retargeting: Build campaigns targeting website visitors and users who have not completed registration or subscription. Performance Optimization: Continuously improve cost per acquisition, trial conversions, paid subscriptions, and return on advertising spend. Reporting: Provide clear performance reports and actionable recommendations. We currently have a promotional offer that can be used to create strong conversion-focused campaigns. Who We're Looking For We strongly prefer freelancers who have: Proven experience running successful Meta Ads campaigns for SaaS businesses. Demonstrable results generating subscriptions, free trials, or qualified signups. Strong knowledge of Meta's advertising algorithms, campaign optimization, and attribution. Experience working with limited initial budgets and scaling campaigns based on results. The ability to work independently and recommend improvements to our landing pages and conversion funnel. We are not looking for someone who simply boosts posts or generates cheap, low-quality traffic. When Applying, Please Answer Have you successfully managed Facebook or Instagram Ads for SaaS companies? Please share examples and actual results. What strategy would you recommend for acquiring paying customers for RepGet? What initial daily advertising budget would you recommend for testing? Can you manage the complete process, including tracking, ad creatives, campaign setup, and optimization? What is your fee for initial setup and ongoing monthly management? Our Goal We want to start with a controlled advertising budget, identify profitable campaigns, and progressively scale based on measurable customer acquisition results. We are interested in building a long-term collaboration with someone who can demonstrate consistent performance. Please review https://www.repget.com before applying and include a brief explanation of how you would approach our first campaign. Generic, copy-paste proposals will not be considered.

opportunities.title: Push-Button Clip CAD Prototyping - Need Modifications to Existing Work
opportunities.description: 3D CAD Designer – STL Modifications, Resin Prototyping & Injection Molding We're looking for an experienced 3D CAD designer to make modifications to existing STL files for a push-button clip assembly. The product is currently in the prototyping and refinement stage, with the finalized designs being submitted to our injection molding manufacturer for commercial production. A critical requirement of this project is that you have access to your own resin 3D printer and are able to physically print, assemble and test your modifications before sending us the updated files. We're currently using an ELEGOO Mars with ELEGOO ABS-Like Resin 3.0 and would prefer someone with comparable equipment and resin. We're looking to minimize the back-and-forth associated with making design changes, only to discover issues once we've printed and assembled the components on our end. Scope of work: - Modify existing STL files based on our instructions, measurements, photographs and feedback. - Adjust component geometry, wall thickness, tolerances, clearances and mechanical features as needed. - Ensure proper fitment, button travel, clip engagement and release, and overall mechanical functionality. - Identify and address potential issues with binding, friction, structural integrity and repeated use. - Physically print, assemble and test revised components prior to delivery. - Ensure modifications take into consideration the requirements and limitations of plastic injection molding. - Make additional refinements based on our own physical testing and feedback. Required experience: - CAD modeling and modification of existing STL files. - Mechanical product design and multi-component assemblies. - Hands-on experience with resin 3D printing. - Experience with clips, push-button mechanisms, snap-fit components or similar mechanical designs. - Understanding of mechanical tolerances and design for injection molding. Deliverables: - Updated, print-ready STL files. - Editable CAD source files and STEP files for manufacturing. - Photos and video demonstrating the functionality of the physically printed and assembled components. - Details of any potential manufacturing concerns identified during the design process. When applying, please include the make and model of your resin 3D printer, the resin and CAD software you use, and examples of relevant mechanical design and prototyping work. Having access to a resin 3D printer and the ability to physically test your work is non-negotiable. Digital renderings, software simulations or filament-based 3D printing alone will not meet the requirements of this project.

Required experience: - CAD modeling and modification of existing STL files. - Mechanical product design and multi-component assemblies. - Hands-on experience with resin 3D printing. - Experience with clips, push-button mechanisms, snap-fit components or similar mechanical designs. - Understanding of mechanical tolerances and design for injection molding. Having access to a resin 3D printer and the ability to physically test your work is non-negotiable. Digital renderings, software simulations or filament-based 3D printing alone will not meet the requirements of this project."

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Software Estadístico con Inteligencia Artificial y Visión por Computadora
opportunities.description: Se requiere un profesional experimentado para el desarrollo de un software estadístico innovador. Este sistema deberá utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial, específicamente identificación facial y visión por computadora, para el monitoreo y análisis de datos relacionados con personas y con pleno cumplimiento a la legislación vigente. El software tendrá la capacidad de integrar diversas fuentes de información, realizar análisis en tiempo real y presentar los resultados de manera efectiva a través de una interfaz de usuario intuitiva, con visualizaciones y reportes de fácil entendimiento. Se valorará la experiencia en procesamiento de datos y en el desarrollo de este tipo de tecnologías avanzadas. Los entregables esperados incluyen el código fuente completo del sistema, documentación técnica detallada, un manual de usuario exhaustivo, así como soporte para el seguimiento, puesta en marcha y los ajustes necesarios del sistema. El prototipo deberá incorporar un sistema de localización GPS. Es fundamental que el software demuestre una elevada tasa de exactitud y sea capaz de operar de manera eficiente en condiciones de luminosidad reducida. Además, toda la información recopilada por el sistema deberá ser enviada a una central remota para su procesamiento y almacenamiento. Los profesionales interesados, deberán mostrar flexibilidad para acordar las condiciones de trabajo y la compensación económica del proyecto, la que será en función del avance del proyecto, considerando eventualmente otras formas de incentivo. También se solicita presentar un presupuesto realista, el que no debe ser modificado sustancialmente posteriormente por el desarrollador. Asimismo el profesional seleccionado deberá previamente al inicio del trabajo, firmar un contrato legalizado por escrito de confidencialidad y cesión de derechos de obra por encargo. Se considerará de manera especial a profesionales chilenos, aunque la selección no sera excluyente y dependerá de las condiciones y propuestas presentadas.

opportunities.title: Google Sheets Progress Report Automation
opportunities.description: I need a streamlined Google Sheets solution that transforms raw project data into clear, up-to-date progress reports and summaries. The job covers designing the sheet layout, writing Google Apps Script macros to pull and aggregate figures, and setting up triggers so the reports refresh on a schedule. Please structure the file so I can see percent complete, overdue items, and upcoming deadlines at a glance, with any charts or conditional formatting that make trends obvious. Code should be efficient and well-commented so I can tweak it later. When you respond, focus on your experience building similar reporting or dashboard systems in Google Sheets and Apps Script. Deliverables: • A fully functional Google Sheet template • All associated Apps Script files, cleanly commented • A brief walkthrough (video or document) explaining how to maintain or extend the setup Include your estimated turnaround and any clarifying questions you may have.

opportunities.title: Chatbot Konseling Cinta Interaktif
opportunities.description: Saya ingin menghadirkan sebuah chatbot yang berperan sebagai “teman curhat” bagi pengguna yang sedang menghadapi persoalan percintaan. Fokus utama versi awal ini adalah membuat pengguna merasa benar-benar didengarkan—tanpa terlebih dahulu memberi nasihat panjang atau menebak kisah mereka. Lingkup kerja yang saya butuhkan: • Rancang alur percakapan empatik berbasis teks: pengguna membuka chat, menceritakan masalahnya, dan bot merespons dengan kalimat pendengar aktif (paraphrasing, validasi emosi, pertanyaan tindak lanjut sederhana). • Bangun chatbot berbasis NLP (contohnya Dialogflow, Rasa, atau teknologi setara) yang dapat mengenali kata kunci emosi dasar dan menjaga nada percakapan tetap suportif. • Implementasi awal cukup di satu kanal (silakan sarankan yang paling efisien—bisa web chat embedded, aplikasi Android ringan, atau integrasi WhatsApp Business API). Fleksibel untuk dikembangkan ke kanal lain nanti. • Panel admin sederhana agar saya bisa memantau log percakapan anonim, menambahkan pola respons baru, dan menonaktifkan bot bila diperlukan. • Dokumentasi singkat penggunaan dan cara memperluas skenario percakapan. Hal yang saya hargai: pengalaman membangun chatbot empatik, pemahaman UX seputar isu sensitif, dan kemampuan menjaga privasi data pengguna. Jika proyek ini berjalan mulus, tahap berikutnya dapat mencakup fitur pemberi saran percintaan atau permainan “tebak kisah” yang lebih interaktif. Kirimkan portofolio relevan dan pendekatan teknis yang Anda bayangkan untuk MVP ini agar saya bisa segera memilih partner terbaik.

opportunities.title: Asesor Comercial Estratégico para Desarrollo de Sistema de Ventas B...
opportunities.organization: Cliente J. C. S. F. (🇨🇴 Colombia)
opportunities.description: Distyle, una marca de ropa deportiva especializada en joggers clásicos unicolor y colecciones limitadas, busca un asesor comercial con sólida experiencia en ventas a consumidor final (B2C). No solo necesitamos un vendedor, sino un profesional capaz de diseñar y estructurar un sistema de ventas integral para nuestra marca. El objetivo principal es transformar nuestras colecciones en lanzamientos exitosos que impulsen las ventas, fomenten la recompra y fortalezcan la fidelización de nuestros clientes. Buscamos a alguien que nos guíe en el desarrollo e implementación de: * Un sistema de ventas eficiente a través de WhatsApp. * Estrategias efectivas para el seguimiento de prospectos. * Tácticas para la recuperación de clientes que no completaron su compra. * Mecanismos para el seguimiento de carritos abandonados en e-commerce. * Técnicas de cierre de ventas probadas. * Elaboración de guiones comerciales optimizados. * Estrategias de recompra para maximizar el valor de vida del cliente. * Programas de fidelización de clientes. * Estrategias para la venta de nuevas colecciones. * Definición de indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPIs) y metas comerciales. Ofrecemos una modalidad de trabajo freelance con pago basado en resultados y la posibilidad de bonificaciones. Esta es una oportunidad para participar activamente en el desarrollo del sistema comercial de una marca deportiva en crecimiento y continuar colaborando si los resultados son exitosos. Si tienes experiencia comprobada en la creación y optimización de sistemas comerciales y deseas contribuir al crecimiento de una marca colombiana, te invitamos a presentar tu propuesta detallando el sistema que implementarías en Distyle. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Otros Tamaño del proyecto: Grande

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Engineer for API Integration
opportunities.description: Company: NuraView Work Mode: 100% Remote Employment Type: Full-Time About NuraView NuraView is a multifaceted marketing and technology-driven agency focused on delivering innovative digital solutions, automation systems, and software-based services to businesses across different industries. We work on diverse projects involving software development, business automation, AI-powered solutions, web applications, and digital infrastructure. We are looking for motivated and technically capable Software Engineers who are interested in working on different projects, solving real-world problems, and contributing to practical software implementations. Role Overview As a Software Engineer at NuraView, you will work across multiple projects and technical requirements depending on business priorities and client needs. Unlike traditional software companies where developers may work on a single project for several months, this is a multifaceted working environment where project requirements and priorities may evolve. You will be expected to adapt to different technical challenges, collaborate with the team, and deliver reliable solutions within planned timelines. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and improve web applications and software solutions. Work on frontend and backend development based on project requirements. Build and integrate APIs, databases, and third-party services. Assist in developing AI-powered applications and business automation systems. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues. Collaborate with project managers and other developers to understand requirements. Work across multiple projects and adapt to changing technical priorities. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Test, debug, and implement solutions into production environments. Provide regular updates on development progress and project completion. Required Skills Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and software development. Knowledge of at least one programming language such as JavaScript, Python, Java, PHP, or similar. Familiarity with web development technologies. Understanding of databases and API integrations. Basic knowledge of Git, GitHub, and version control. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to different project requirements. Good communication and teamwork skills. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. Previous experience in software development or personal/academic projects. Familiarity with modern frameworks such as React, Next.js, Node.js, Django, or similar. Exposure to AI tools, LLMs, automation platforms, or cloud technologies is an advantage. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and demonstrable projects are welcome to apply. What We Expect A proactive approach to solving technical problems. Accountability for assigned tasks and deadlines. Willingness to work on different types of projects. Ability to understand requirements before starting development. Consistent communication and progress reporting. Flexibility to learn and work with different technologies when required. Please Note: NuraView is a multifaceted agency, not a traditional technical corporation where developers are assigned to one fixed project for an extended period. Project requirements and priorities may change depending on business needs. However, work will be properly planned, assigned, and managed to ensure reasonable execution and delivery. How to Apply Interested candidates can submit their applications through the application form provided below. Please do not contact or email the company's founder directly regarding this job opportunity. All applications must be submitted through the official application process. Direct emails to the founder regarding recruitment will result in application rejection. Apply Now and Become Part of NuraView!

opportunities.title: Interior & Social Media Graphics
opportunities.description: This project combines two creative assignments that need to flow seamlessly together. First, a complete modern interior design package is required. The space mix is broad—think living areas, workspaces, and even retail corners—so the solution must be flexible enough to look cohesive across different room types. I will provide exact room measurements once we start. The scope covers space planning, furniture layout, lighting concepts, and high-definition photo-realistic renders. A full-length walkthrough video moving through each room will be the key presentation piece, so confident use of AutoCAD, 3Ds Max or SketchUp alongside Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator is essential. Second, I also need a matching set of eye-catching promotional posts for Instagram and Facebook that carry the same visual language established in the interiors. These should be delivered in ready-to-publish formats and layered source files so I can tweak text later if needed. Deliverables – Floor plan(s) and furniture placement drawings – Lighting, colour and material boards – HD renders (JPEG + layered source) – Walkthrough video of the entire design – Social media ad creatives (final PNG/JPEG + PSD/AI) All work must be original, on-brand, and submitted on the agreed schedule.

opportunities.title: Virtual Assistant for Tutoring Business
opportunities.description: Requirements – Virtual Personal Assistant for Private Tutoring Business - Manage the day-to-day administrative activities of my private tutoring business, Build My Future Classes. - Have a good understanding of Economics, Business Studies, Management and related academic terminology. - Be familiar with international education systems, particularly IB, Cambridge IGCSE, O Level, Edexcel/Pearson, CBSE and ICSE. - Understand basic course structures, subject requirements, examination patterns and academic terminology. - Create and manage a professional LinkedIn profile and Instagram business account. - Regularly update social media profiles with educational content, promotional posts, announcements and relevant information. - Use Canva and AI tools such as ChatGPT to create professional social media content. - Prepare and maintain a structured weekly and monthly teaching timetable. - Coordinate student availability with my schedule and avoid overlapping class timings. - Confirm all class schedules with students and parents in advance. - Send WhatsApp reminders and manage class rescheduling. - Maintain a student database containing contact details, subjects, curriculum, fees and class schedules. - Track classes conducted, pending classes, cancellations and attendance. - Respond professionally to student and parent enquiries. - Follow up with prospective students and maintain an enquiry tracker. - Maintain organised records using Google Sheets, Excel and Google Calendar. - Assist with course descriptions, promotional material and academic business documentation. - Research opportunities and platforms to attract new students and expand the tutoring business. - Prepare a concise daily or weekly work report. - Be proactive, dependable, organised and capable of working independently. Skills required - Excellent English communication. - Google Workspace, MS Excel and PowerPoint. - Canva, Instagram and LinkedIn management. - WhatsApp Business. - ChatGPT and other AI productivity tools. - Strong scheduling and coordination skills. Preferred candidate: Someone with experience in academic administration, tutoring businesses, education management or business administration. Engagement: Part-time, long-term opportunity, approximately 2–3 hours daily initially. Attach your answers to the following before bid: 1. Have you previously worked as a Virtual Assistant, Academic Coordinator or Education Administrator? 2. Are you familiar with IB, Cambridge IGCSE, O Level, Edexcel and CBSE curricula? 3. Do you have basic knowledge of Economics, Business Studies and Management terminology? 4. Can you independently manage student timetables, schedule classes and coordinate with parents? 5. Are you proficient in Google Calendar, Excel and Google Sheets? 6. Have you created and managed professional LinkedIn and Instagram business profiles? 7. Can you independently create social media posts, captions and monthly content calendars using Canva and AI tools? 8. Are you comfortable handling student enquiries, WhatsApp communication and follow-ups? 9. Can you dedicate 2–3 hours daily during Indian working hours on a long-term basis? 10. What is your expected monthly payment in INR? Important: I am looking for someone who can take ownership of administrative and coordination responsibilities, not merely someone who completes tasks when instructed.

opportunities.title: NinjaTrader 8 Trade Journal Panel
opportunities.description: Project Title: KK Trade Journal NT8 (C# / NinjaScript) Project Description: I need a NinjaScript (C#) developer to build a custom collapsible on-chart Trade Journal panel for NinjaTrader 8. I already have the open-source (.cs) code for my custom indicator that plots named on the level to trade. Core Requirements: Integration: Connect to my existing open-source indicator to capture the exact Level Name whenever a trade is executed. Session Reset (6:00 PM EST): The table must automatically clear and reset every day at 6:00 PM (futures session open). At 6:00 PM, the table starts empty (0 rows). Dynamic Row Grouping (1 Row per Traded Level): Only display levels that have been traded during the current session (e.g., if 2 levels are traded, show 2 rows; when a 3rd new level is traded, add a 3rd row). Multiple Trades on the Same Level: Do not create a duplicate row. Update the existing row for that level with the latest trade info and cumulative stats. Required Table Columns (Per Level Row): Date & Time: Timestamp of the most recent trade on this level. Level Name: Name pulled from my existing indicator (e.g., Weekly_High, Daily_Open). Last Direction: Current/most recent trade direction (Buy or Sell). Last Result: Outcome of the most recent trade (Win or Loss). Total Trades: Total number of times this level has been traded today. Buy / Sell Count: Breakdown of Buy vs. Sell trades on this level (e.g., 2B / 1S). Win / Loss Count: Breakdown of Wins vs. Losses on this level (e.g., 2W / 1L). Overall Level PnL: Cumulative net profit/loss (currency and/or ticks) for all trades taken on this specific level during the session. Account name UI / Collapsible Panel: Render the table cleanly on the chart using SharpDX (or WPF) with a Minimize/Collapse button so I can hide or expand it with one click. CSV Export (Bonus/Optional): Log each individual closed trade to a daily CSV file for long-term Excel analysis. Deliverables: Clean, well-commented open-source .cs file and .zip import package for NinjaTrader 8. opportunities.title: Email Management Specialist Needed
opportunities.description: Job Title Local AU Developer (Mac mini Desktop Computer - Apple M4 chip, Built for Apple Intelligence, 10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 16GB Memory, 256GB SSD Storage) for Email, RouteOne/Axcessa CIT Workflows Project Overview I am setting up a new 16GB Apple Mac Mini and looking for an experienced AI automation engineer to build and configure a private, local-first multi-agent system remotely. I want a modular, visual workflow setup (such as self-hosted n8n paired with Ollama or LM Studio running Apple MLX models) so the system runs locally on my Mac, keeps sensitive dealership and personal data private, and allows me to easily monitor, pause, or adjust workflows myself after handoff. Core Workflows Required 1. Personal & Work Email Management • Connect both my personal and work email accounts (separate routing and rules for each). • Automatically classify incoming messages by urgency and category, extract requested action items/calendar tasks, and generate context-aware draft replies (draft-first policy—no auto-sending without approval). 2. RouteOne (Automotive Platform) Monitoring • Monitor and parse incoming RouteOne notifications and lender emails from initial deal approval through final funding. • Extract key fields including Customer Name, Deal/Stock Number, Lender, and Status Stage (Approved, Contract Submitted, Stipulations Needed, Pending Funding, or Paid/Funded). • Navigate the website and read information directly from displayed tables. 3. NCM Axcessa — Contracts in Transit (CIT) Automated Note Updates • Build a secure browser-automation workflow (Playwright or Browser-Use triggered by n8n) using a persistent browser profile/session to handle authentication smoothly. • Locate the matching deal inside the NCM Axcessa Contracts in Transit (CIT) report and append a concise, timestamped status note (e.g., MM/DD HH:MM [STAGE] Summary - via RouteOne) without overwriting existing notes. • Include duplicate-note protection (checking existing notes before posting) and a retry queue (re-checking every 2–3 hours if a brand-new RouteOne deal has not yet synced from our DMS into Axcessa). • Once a deal reaches Paid/Funded, mark it complete and exclude it from active tracking. Include aged/stalled deals (e.g., unfunded past 5–7 days) in a daily morning digest. Technical & Security Requirements • Apple Silicon Optimization: Proven experience deploying local LLMs on macOS using Apple MLX (via LM Studio or Ollama) and managing context/RAM limits so multiple agents run smoothly within 16GB unified memory. • Visual Orchestration & Browser Automation: Strong hands-on experience with n8n and Playwright (handling dynamic web tables, session persistence, and error retries). • Security-First Design: All credentials stored locally in macOS Keychain or encrypted environment variables—never hardcoded in prompts. • Handoff & Documentation: Full remote setup via screen share/SSH, clean documentation, and a recorded walkthrough video showing how to restart services, view logs, edit workflows. Additionally include the ability for me to modify or make changes to the workflow as needed. How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. 1–2 examples of local LLM, n8n, or Playwright browser-automation workflows you have built. 2. Your recommended tech stack for this Mac mini setup. 3. Your estimated timeline and either a fixed-price quote or hourly rate + estimated hours.

Communication : Excellente aisance relationnelle et rédactionnelle (en français et/ou en anglais). Autonomie et rigueur : Forte capacité d'organisation pour travailler à distance, gérer son pipeline commercial et assurer un reporting régulier.

opportunities.title: Full Home Classic Interior Design
opportunities.description: I need every room of my home brought together under one cohesive, classic-and-elegant vision, and I’m ready to move quickly. From the entryway to the bedrooms, I want timeless lines, refined detailing, and a palette that feels sophisticated rather than stuffy. The project is for the entire home (multiple rooms), so space planning must flow naturally room-to-room while still letting each area have its own moment. Share concepts through mood boards first, then refine them into detailed floor plans and realistic 3-D renders. AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, or any comparable tool is fine so long as source files are included. Because the timeline is ASAP, I’ll expect rapid iteration: a first concept within a few days, followed by quick feedback rounds until final approval. Deliverables I will sign off on: • Mood boards and color/material palettes • Scaled floor plans with furniture layout • High-quality 3-D renders (day and night lighting) • A concise specification sheet listing furniture, fixtures, and finishes with purchase links or codes All files should be handed over in editable format plus print-ready PDFs. If this scope and pace excite you, let’s get started right away.

opportunities.title: Fanuc VMC CNC Program Creation
opportunities.description: I have a set of part drawings in AutoCAD and now need them translated into a ready-to-run CNC program for a Fanuc-controlled vertical machining centre. The geometry is complete; what matters now is a clean, efficient tool-path strategy and proven G-code that the operator can load without tweaking. You’ll work directly from my DWG files, choose appropriate cutters, set feeds and speeds, and output standard Fanuc G-code. A concise setup sheet—listing tools, offsets, and any critical notes—should accompany the program so the shop floor can get up and running quickly. Deliverables: • Fanuc-compatible G-code for each part • Matching setup / tooling sheet in PDF or Excel • Any CAM project files used (Fusion 360, Mastercam, etc.) for traceability The code must post with no alarms on a Fanuc 0i-series controller and hit the features on the print within tolerance; once virtual verification (or back-plot) shows clear, I’ll prove it out on the machine.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40820997, publicado hace 8 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 37,500 - 75,000.

opportunities.title: SketchUp Interiors for ATMA House
opportunities.description: Interior Designer Required – Furniture Planning & 3D SketchUp Design (3-Day Deadline) Project: ATMA House – Recycled Textile Incubation Centre, Ahmedabad I am looking for an Interior Designer / Architect who can help me complete the interior design development of my academic thesis project. I will provide all the basic information, including: - Existing AutoCAD floor plans. - Basic 3D model of the building. - Building sections. - Space programme and area requirements. - Design concept and reference images. - Other necessary design details and instructions. Work Required I need someone who can take my provided drawings and requirements and complete the following work: 1. Furniture Layout Planning - Design furniture layouts for the required floors. - Plan furniture according to the activities and space requirements. - Arrange furniture with proper circulation and functional zoning. - Suggest suitable furniture, partitions and interior arrangements. 2. Interior Sections - Develop interior sections based on the provided building sections. - Show furniture placement, partitions, ceiling details and interior elements. - Add necessary dimensions and detailing. 3. 3D Modelling in SketchUp - Work on the basic 3D building model that I provide. - Develop the proposed interior design in SketchUp. - Add furniture, partitions, materials, lighting and other interior elements. - Create basic 3D views to communicate the design. Important Requirements - This is an academic Interior Design thesis project. - The design should be at a good academic presentation level. - I will provide the basic planning, drawings, requirements and references. - You only need to develop the interior planning, furniture layouts, sections and 3D design based on my instructions. - Preserve the existing building structure and architectural elements. - No major architectural or structural changes are required. Final Deliverables - Completed AutoCAD files (.dwg) for furniture layouts and sections. - Editable SketchUp file (.skp) with the proposed interior design. - PDF exports of the final drawings. - Basic 3D views/screenshots of the designed spaces. Important – Deadline: The complete work must be finished within 3 days from the start of the project. Please apply only if you can meet this deadline and are comfortable working with the drawings and requirements I provide. I am looking for someone who can understand my instructions, coordinate with me during the process and complete the work efficiently. Please share your portfolio, availability for the next 3 days and your quotation.

opportunities.title: Daily 3D YouTube Editing
opportunities.description: I publish YouTube content every day and I’m looking for a reliable 3-D video editor who can take each raw recording from first cut to final upload-ready file. The core of the job is full editing with 3-D graphics, seamless cuts, music beds, sound design, and on-screen captions. Every episode begins with a short animated intro and ends with an equally branded outro, so you’ll handle those elements as well. Typical workflow • I drop the footage, script notes, and any reference assets into a shared Google Drive/Dropbox folder. • You create the 3-D intro/outro (Blender, Cinema 4D, or your preferred tool), layer in dynamic titles, lower thirds, and any in-video 3-D call-outs I request. • Sync the edit with background music and add transitions that feel natural for YouTube—nothing jarring. • Add captions (SRT and burnt-in) and return a polished 1080p or 4K master plus a thumbnail frame. Turnaround is usually 24 – 48 hours per video; consistency is more important than speed, but I do release daily, so meeting deadlines is crucial. Deliverables each day 1. Final video file (MP4, H.264) 2. Separate SRT captions 3. Thumbnail still (PNG) 4. Project files so I can make minor tweaks if needed Acceptance criteria • Audio stays in sync and levels are balanced. • 3-D elements match my brand colors and typography. • No copyright claims on music or graphics. • Final file passes YouTube checks without further tweaks. If you’re comfortable juggling daily workflow, keeping branding tight, and elevating videos with tasteful 3-D flourishes, I’m ready to start immediately and keep you busy long-term.

opportunities.title: Auditar y cerrar app de gestión existente en Base44 (cultivo y trazabilidad)
opportunities.description: Empezá tu propuesta con la palabra FLORA4 (así sé que leíste todo). Tengo una app de gestión interna ya armada y en uso diario, hecha en Base44: pantallas, 57 tablas, 6 roles de usuario y datos cargados, con unas 13 personas usándola desde el celular. NO hay que hacerla de cero ni rediseñarla. Busco un desarrollador con experiencia que la revise, le dé estructura y la deje cerrada y confiable. RUBRO Dispensario solidario de cannabis medicinal de Buenos Aires, que opera a través de una asociación civil dentro del marco regulatorio argentino. La app sigue la planta desde el esqueje hasta el gramo dispensado. ALCANCE Y PRIORIDADES Prioridad 1 - Registro y seguimiento de cultivo: genéticas, madres, lotes de esquejes, plantas por sala y posición, movimientos entre salas, cosecha, secado, manicura y control de pesos. Tiene que quedar trazable de punta a punta, de la genética a la cosecha. Prioridad 2 - Stock de flores: depósito, tránsito, recepción confirmada en el local, dispensa y retorno, sin que el stock pueda quedar descuadrado. Fuera de alcance en esta etapa: caja diaria, cierres, gastos y finanzas. Eso queda como está. QUÉ HAY QUE HACER 1. Auditoría corta de la parte de cultivo y stock (modelo de datos, permisos por rol y lógica) con un informe de 1 o 2 páginas: qué está bien, qué está flojo y qué conviene ordenar. 2. Cerrar la trazabilidad de cultivo: que cada planta se pueda seguir desde su origen hasta la cosecha, sin plantas duplicadas, perdidas o en la sala equivocada. 3. Cerrar el circuito de flores (sin egresos sin stock, sin duplicados, y sin recepción confirmada no se dispensa). 4. Corregir las fallas ya relevadas de cultivo y stock (te paso el listado priorizado). 5. Revisar la seguridad: que cada rol vea y modifique solo lo suyo a nivel de datos, no solo de pantallas. 6. Dejar el respaldo automático verificado y una guía breve de cómo está armada la app. LO QUE YA ESTÁ Pantallas, tablas, roles, datos, listado de fallas y un brief funcional completo con las reglas de negocio. Es trabajo de ordenar y cerrar, no de construir. CONDICIONES - Experiencia comprobable en Base44, o en plataformas parecidas (React con backend como servicio). - Se trabaja sobre mi cuenta. El código y los datos son míos. - Acuerdo de confidencialidad antes de dar acceso. - Precio fijo en dos hitos: (1) auditoría e informe, (2) correcciones y cierre. - Trabajo y comunicación en español. TU PROPUESTA TIENE QUE INCLUIR 1. La palabra de control al inicio. 2. Uno o dos trabajos tuyos en Base44 o similares, con enlace o capturas. 3. Precio y plazo de cada hito. 4. Dudas que te deje esta descripción. 5. Aparte y sin compromiso: cuánto costaría, más adelante, mudar la app a un servidor propio.

opportunities.title: Boost Zambian Airbnb Bookings Online
opportunities.description: The immediate priority is to turn our Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok presence into a steady stream of confirmed Airbnb and apartment bookings in Lusaka, Zambia. Current pages are active but under-performing; what’s missing is a cohesive strategy, engaging content, and targeted ad campaigns that convert followers into paying guests. Scope of work • Audit the three existing profiles to pinpoint gaps in messaging, branding, and call-to-action flow. • Design a 30-day content calendar (mix of photos, Reels, Stories, and short-form videos) that highlights room features, guest reviews, neighborhood attractions, and limited-time offers. • Set up and manage paid ads optimized for conversions—custom audiences, retargeting, and A/B testing included. • Establish performance benchmarks (reach, engagement, click-through, booking rate) and deliver weekly reports so adjustments stay data-driven. • Recommend low-lift automation tools for messaging and follow-ups that keep potential guests warm until they book. Acceptance criteria 1. Organic reach and engagement both improve by at least 25% within the first month. 2. Ads achieve a cost-per-booking target agreed on before launch. 3. Clear reporting dashboard provided by the end of every week. When responding, focus on relevant experience running conversion-focused campaigns for short-term rentals or hotels, plus any results you can share. Links to past work or case studies are welcome but not mandatory—concise proof of experience is what matters most here.

opportunities.title: Excel Report & Chart Automation
opportunities.description: I have a workbook that should generate management-ready reports and visual dashboards automatically instead of relying on manual copying, filtering, and chart updates. The workflow I have in mind is simple for the end user: drop raw data into a sheet or connect to an external source, press a single button, and watch the entire report pack refresh—tables updated, charts rebuilt, and everything formatted consistently for printing or PDF export. To succeed here, the solution will need to cover: • Building Excel dashboards and charts that stay linked to the underlying data • Automating report creation with formulas, VBA macros, or Power Query—whatever is most reliable and maintainable • Handling large data files, including any cleanup, deduplication, or re-structuring required before the analysis layer runs Deliverables I expect: 1. A fully automated routine (macro, query, or both) that imports/refreshes data, performs necessary transformations, and updates all report sheets and charts. 2. At least one consolidated “Summary” sheet with dynamic tables and visualisations ready for management review. 3. Well-commented code or a short how-to note so I can adapt the solution as new data fields appear. When you reply, show relevant experience achieving similar Excel automation—especially examples where dashboards or periodic reports now regenerate with a single click. No lengthy proposals needed; a concise summary of past wins in this exact space will help me gauge fit quickly.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40820922, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 600 - 1,500.

opportunities.title: Polish Existing Excel Workbook
opportunities.description: I’ve taken my Excel workbook as far as I can and now need an expert touch to push it over the finish line. The file already contains all of the data and a rough structure; what I’m missing is the finesse—clean formatting, reliable formulas, light automation where it truly helps, and a layout that feels intuitive the moment you open it. Here’s what I’d like from you: • Review the entire workbook, spot inconsistencies, and suggest practical improvements. • Fix or streamline any formulas so every number updates correctly—no #REF! or circular-reference surprises. • Apply professional-looking formatting and clear data-validation rules so the sheet is hard to break and easy to read. • Add VBA or Power Query only if it meaningfully reduces manual steps; otherwise keep things simple. • Leave a brief change log and inline comments so I can follow your logic later. Acceptance criteria • Workbook opens in Microsoft 365 with zero security or compatibility warnings. • All original data remains intact. • Formulas recalculate accurately after sample edits. • Final file feels publication-ready for colleagues or clients. Once we start, I’ll share the current workbook and walk you through any quirks. I’m aiming for a quick, collaborative turnaround and a polished file I can trust going forward.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Support Platform with Chatbots
opportunities.description: I need a robust, cloud-hosted platform that lets my team handle customer support on WhatsApp at scale. The first release must connect to the official WhatsApp Business API and give us a clean web interface where automatic replies and AI-driven chatbots pick up routine questions before a human ever needs to step in. Core expectations • End-to-end setup of the WhatsApp Business API (or Twilio/360dialog if that suits the architecture) • A rules-based and/or NLP chatbot builder that I can tweak without writing code • Real-time monitoring so I can see when a bot hands off to an agent and how fast issues are resolved • Secure user management and logging that can grow with additional teams in the future Nice-to-haves such as a shared inbox or rich customer profiles can be left loosely coupled for later sprints, but the codebase should be modular enough to drop them in without rewrites. Deliverables 1. Source code in a Git repository with README and environment setup instructions 2. Deployed staging instance for UAT plus a production-ready deployment script (Docker or similar) 3. Short video walk-through demonstrating the chatbot flow, handoff logic and admin dashboard Send me a detailed project proposal that spells out your tech stack, milestone plan, and any prior work using the WhatsApp Business API. I will shortlist based on the clarity of your architecture and the realism of your timeline.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40820896, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 200 - 500.

opportunities.title: Park Furniture Assembly Drawings
opportunities.description: I need simple but clear, production-ready assembly drawings for outdoor park furniture—benches, picnic tables, trash bins, bicycle stands, and a few similar items. Scope Each drawing must show 2D and in different perspectives plus exploded or cut-away view that identify individual parts, their basic measurements, and the way they fit together. opportunities.title: Kitbash Character Model from Illustration (Modular STL Parts)
opportunities.description: Recreate the attached illustration (stylized female warrior: short brown bob, freckles, blue scarf, slate gray-blue tunic, tan leather belt and bracers, dark trousers, tall boots, longsword) as a kitbash miniature kit: every part is a separate, watertight STL that we assemble virtually in 3D software before printing. Parts share one world position so any combination imports flush together — this is the first kit in a parts library where torsos, boots, belts, weapons, etc. swap freely across future characters. Kitbash Spec (mandatory) - All parts modeled in place on a shared armature: every file imported at origin (0,0,0) aligns into the full figure with zero adjustment. - Seam edges (neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles, waist) must have matching contours — flush, no gaps or steps, with ~0.2–0.3 mm overlap so the digitally assembled figure prints solid. - Standard seam layout will be reused across all future kits — treat it as spec, not preference. - Demonstrate at least one swap at delivery (e.g., barefoot or alternate hand variant). Technical - 32mm heroic scale (feet-to-eye ~35 mm). - Watertight, manifold, walls ≥ 0.5 mm, no non-uniform scaling. - Source: Blender (.blend) preferred, each part a separate named object. - Naming: model_[part]_[L|R].stl. Milestones - Paid test — $10: Model 2–3 parts of our choosing (e.g., one boot, the belt, one hand). Verifies understanding of in-place alignment and seam spec before full commitment. Paid immediately on acceptance. - 25% — Blockout: Low-detail parts cut at all standard seams, shared world position. Approval gate before detailing. - 40% — Full sculpt: All parts per illustration; delivery includes assembly renders (front/back/side) proving flush alignment + one part-swap render. - 20% — Print prep: Pre-supported files, FDM notes, one test-print revision round. - 15% — Final: All STL/3MF, source file, full-figure STL, one-page exploded assembly PDF. How to Apply (read carefully) Briefly answer: - How you keep multiple part files aligned to a shared world position across separate exports. - One shipped kitbash/multi-part miniature project (link to pictures or files). - Estimated hours and hourly rate. - I won't read people applying with AI. Do not lost your time and mine. Terms - Hand-sculpted only. AI-generated meshes (Meshy, Rodin, image-to-3D, etc.) = immediate termination without payment. We check. - No asset-store bases or recycled kits. - Full commercial rights to all files, derivatives, and the seam spec. - One revision round per milestone; scope changes quoted separately.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp & Email Customer Support
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan seseorang yang bisa memantau WhatsApp dan email bisnis saya sepanjang hari kerja dan memberikan jawaban secepat mungkin—idealnya di bawah satu jam—kepada setiap pelanggan. Mayoritas pesan yang masuk berkaitan dengan keluhan seputar pesanan serta permintaan detail harga atau metode pembayaran, jadi kepekaan terhadap nada bicara dan ketepatan informasi sangat penting. Semua balasan harus ditulis secara personal, bukan sekadar menempelkan template. Silakan gunakan template internal saya hanya sebagai panduan data; gaya bahasa dan pendekatan harus disesuaikan dengan situasi dan emosi pelanggan saat itu. Saya perlu laporan singkat harian tentang interaksi penting, isu yang belum terselesaikan, dan rekomendasi perbaikan alur jika ada. Keahlian komunikasi tertulis dalam Bahasa Indonesia wajib; kemampuan Inggris menjadi nilai tambah karena beberapa pelanggan internasional mungkin muncul. Familiaritas dengan WhatsApp Web, Gmail, dan spreadsheet dasar akan mempermudah pekerjaan.

opportunities.title: Freelance Business Development & Client Acquisition Specialist – AI Compony
opportunities.description: Project Type: Long-Term Freelance Collaboration Payment: Fixed Monthly Retainer + Performance-Based Commission Experience: 1–3 Years Preferred About the Project We are an UK based AI-focused Compony providing AI-powered business solutions, automation systems, AI-generated videos, creative content, and professional website development. We are looking for a result-oriented Business Development Specialist who can acquire genuine international clients and convert business opportunities into long-term paying customers. Responsibilities Find and acquire potential international clients. Generate qualified B2B leads through LinkedIn, cold emails, and other channels. Identify startup founders, CEOs, business owners, and decision-makers. Pitch AI automation, AI agents, creative content, and website development services. Conduct discovery calls, negotiate pricing, and close deals. Manage client communication and follow-ups. Secure project approvals, signed agreements, and advance payments. Build long-term client relationships. Monthly Target Minimum 3–4 new paying clients per month. We prioritise genuine clients with actual business requirements and long-term working potential, not random or unverified leads. Compensation Structure Fixed Monthly Retainer: ₹8,000–₹12,000 (negotiable). Commission: 5–10% on successfully closed deals. Additional Incentives: Performance bonuses for exceeding targets, acquiring additional clients, securing advance payments, and faster deal closures. Commission will be based on actual payments received, under mutually agreed terms. Requirements Experience in B2B sales, lead generation, or business development. Proven international client acquisition experience. Excellent English communication and negotiation skills. Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, Hunter.io, or similar tools. Ability to manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting to deal closure. Please share your previous experience, successful client acquisition examples, preferred compensation, and your strategy for acquiring 3–4 paying clients monthly. We are looking for a serious, proactive professional interested in a long-term working relationship.

opportunities.title: Trend-Driven Short-Form Growth Manager
opportunities.description: Project Title: Organic Growth Creator & Short-Form Video Manager (Trend-Driven Reels & Shorts) Project Description: Looking for a creative short-form video creator or social media growth specialist to completely manage and grow our brand’s Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok pages from scratch. I want to be 100% hands-off with content creation and posting. I will ship our physical product directly to you, and you will handle trend research, filming, retention editing, captions, and daily posting. Content Style & Strategy (Crucial): • 80/20 Trend-to-Pitch Ratio: Do NOT make boring "buy this product" ads. 80% of our content must be purely entertainment, relatable POVs, niche humor, and trending audio formats where the product is simply used naturally in the background ("Trojan Horse" style). • High-Retention Hooks: Every video must hook the viewer in the first 2 seconds with visual movement or a relatable problem—never start with a brand name or sales pitch. • Algorithm Optimization: Content must be engineered for watch time, saves, and DM shares rather than vanity likes. Monthly Deliverables: • 15–20 High-Retention Short Videos/Month (filmed, edited, and formatted for vertical 9:16). • Cross-Platform Management: Daily/consistent scheduling across Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok, including trending audio selection, SEO captions, and hashtag research. • DM Funnel Setup: Basic comment-to-DM automation setup (e.g., ManyChat) so viral videos automatically drive traffic to our store link without pitching in the video. • Weekly Trend & Analytics Check-in: Quick summary of what hooks are performing best so we can double down on winning formats. To Apply, Please Include: 1. Links to 2–3 Instagram Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts you filmed/edited that got high organic views or shares. 2. Confirmation that you are comfortable filming on camera or creating aesthetic POV/hands-only product content. 3. Your proposed monthly retainer rate for 15–20 videos + full page management.

opportunities.title: Warm Minimalist Home Interior Design
opportunities.description: I’m working on a large-scale residential remodel and need a fresh set of creative eyes to shape the aesthetic direction of nine key spaces. The overall mood is warm, modern, and minimal—think clean lines, natural textures, and a comforting palette that still feels current. The living room, kitchen, and dining area are the heart of this home and will require the most attention, although the remaining rooms still need cohesive finishes and accurate plans. I’ll rely on you to translate my concept sketches and measurements into clear, simple 3D views that communicate layout and overall style. No hyper-realistic renders are necessary; speed and clarity are more valuable than photoreal detail. To keep the workflow smooth, I need: • One set of straightforward 3D perspectives for each space • A finish schedule that lists flooring, paint, tile, fixtures, and any specialty materials • Dimensional layouts (PDF and DWG) that a contractor can follow without guesswork You’ll be working remotely on a freelance basis, but I’m available for quick check-ins, Zoom walkthroughs, and real-time screen shares to keep decisions moving. If you’re a junior to intermediate interior designer—or an experienced e-designer comfortable with residential projects—and your portfolio shows warm minimal interiors, let’s talk. Please share relevant samples, outline the software you prefer (SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD, or similar), and give me an estimated turnaround for the initial round of visuals once you have full measurements in hand.

opportunities.title: Senior Fashion Designer for Swiss Premium Menswear Brand
opportunities.description: We are a newly established Swiss-based premium menswear startup seeking an experienced Senior Fashion Designer to lead brand identity development and a debut menswear collection. This is a project-based collaboration with strong potential for a long-term partnership. We are developing a four-piece initial collection consisting of a regular-fit tee, oversized tee, oversized hoodie, and polo shirt. We need a designer who can translate Swiss-inspired elegance, understated luxury, and timeless design into both a cohesive brand identity and production-ready technical documentation. Requirements: - Minimum 8–12 years of fashion design experience, with a focus on premium menswear - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand identity work and menswear garment design (T-shirts, hoodies, polos) - Proficiency in technical flat drawing and tech pack development - Experience with fabric specifications, GSM selection, BOM creation, and size grading (S to XL) - Ability to develop original logo concepts and color palettes with a premium, Swiss-inspired aesthetic - Familiarity with Autodesk AutoCAD, Gemini CAD, or equivalent fashion design tools - Fashion illustration skills for concept presentation - Understanding of garment construction, stitching logic, and fit across menswear categories - Willingness to sign an NDA before project commencement Deliverables: - Logo concept(s) and initial brand identity direction (color palette, typography references, design language) - Original design concepts for all four garments - Front and back technical flats for each style - Realistic garment mockups - Complete Bill of Materials (BOM) per style - Stitching instructions and construction notes - Measurement charts and size grading from S to XL - Production-ready tech packs with zero ambiguity for the manufacturer This is an hourly engagement. We anticipate an initial scoped phase covering brand identity and the four-piece collection, with the opportunity to continue as a long-term design partner as the brand grows. About the project: This is a confidential Swiss premium fashion startup at the early brand-building stage, focused on creating a distinctive, high-quality menswear identity that stands apart in the premium market.

opportunities.title: SDR Telefónico B2B para Pymes Españolas
opportunities.description: El Proyecto: Somos BuzzBlend SL, consultora tecnológica en España. Buscamos un SDR / Appointment Setter telefónico para contactar con decisores de pymes españolas y agendar reuniones de cualificación. Te damos toda la infraestructura: Leads en bandeja: Base de datos B2B ya extraída y cualificada. Herramientas listas: Trabajas desde nuestra plataforma interna con CRM, correo y llamadas VoIP integradas. Soporte: Guiones y gestión de objeciones. Remuneración (100% a Éxito - Comisiones hasta 1.000€): Pagamos por cliente cerrado (cita agendada por ti que termina en venta). Usamos un sistema de rápel retroactivo, los pagos se liberan por hitos: Base: 450€ por cada venta cerrada. Desde la 6ª venta: 550€ por venta (y se regularizan las 5 anteriores a 550€ también). Desde la 11ª venta: 650€ por venta (y anteriores). Desde la 16ª venta: 750€ por venta (y anteriores). Tope: Hasta 1.000€ de comisión por cliente. Requisitos: Experiencia demostrable en Cold Calling B2B a pymes españolas. Español nativo o neutro perfecto. FILTRO ANTI-SPAM: Para descartar bots, debes empezar tu propuesta respondiendo a esto: "Llamas a una pyme y recepción te dice: 'El jefe está ocupado, mándanos un email y ya lo mira'. ¿Cómo debates esto para conseguir la cita?" (Descartaré las propuestas que no respondan a esto).

opportunities.title: Chatbot WhatsApp Pedidos y Reservas
opportunities.description: Necesito habilitar respuestas automáticas en mi cuenta de WhatsApp Business para gestionar pedidos y reservas de forma fluida. El flujo ideal es simple: el bot saluda, solicita nombre y datos de contacto y confirma el pedido o la reserva. Toda esa información debe enviarse y guardarse directamente en el sistema de gestión que ya uso (dispongo de API/webhooks y credenciales). Busco a alguien que: • Diseñe los mensajes y lógica conversacional en español. • Configure el chatbot en la plataforma que mejor se adapte (Twilio, Meta Cloud API, Dialogflow, ManyChat, etc.). • Integre el envío de los datos capturados con mi sistema existente, garantizando que cada registro llegue completo y sin duplicados. • Pruebe el proceso extremo a extremo y me entregue una guía breve para futuros ajustes. Valoraré experiencia previa en WhatsApp Business API e integraciones con ERPs o CRMs.

opportunities.title: Asistente Virtual Administrativo Remoto
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo remoto para mantener mi flujo de trabajo ordenado y a mis clientes bien atendidos. La prioridad inmediata será la Organización de documentos, archivos y correos; igualmente necesito ayuda constante en la Atención a clientes y coordinación de citas. Trabajo cada día dentro de Microsoft Office y Outlook, Google Drive, Gmail y Google Calendar, y complemento todo con un sistema propio de gestión, por lo que debes sentirte cómodo alternando entre estas plataformas sin perder ritmo ni precisión. El contacto con mis clientes será directo y variado: tendrás que Responder correos y mensajes, Atender llamadas y confirmar citas y, cuando sea necesario, Gestionar consultas, cambios y reclamos. Entregables concretos • Bandeja de entrada clasificada y al día, con archivos pertinentes debidamente guardados. • Calendario al minuto con citas confirmadas y recordatorios ajustados. • Registro de interacciones con clientes documentado en el sistema interno. Si puedes aportar proactividad, atención al detalle y una comunicación clara, me encantará contar contigo y acordar un esquema de colaboración de largo plazo.

La prioridad inmediata será la Organización de documentos, archivos y correos; igualmente necesito ayuda constante en la Atención a clientes y coordinación de citas. Trabajo cada día dentro de Microsoft Office y Outlook, Google Drive, Gmail y Google Calendar, y complemento todo con un sistema propio de gestión, por lo que debes sentirte cómodo alternando entre estas plataformas sin perder ritmo ni precisión. El contacto con mis clientes será directo y variado: tendrás que Responder correos y mensajes, Atender llamadas y confirmar citas y, cuando sea necesario, Gestionar consultas, cambios y reclamos. Entregables concretos • Bandeja de entrada clasificada y al día, con archivos pertinentes debidamente guardados. • Calendario al minuto con citas confirmadas y recordatorios ajustados. • Registro de interacciones con clientes documentado en el sistema interno. Si puedes aportar proactividad, atención al detalle y una comunicación clara, me encantará contar contigo y acordar un esquema de colaboración de largo plazo."
requirements_list: Requisitos técnicos solicitados: Data Entry, Virtual Assistant, Customer Service, Time Management, Microsoft Office, Email Handling, Administrative Support, Appointment Setting.

opportunities.title: Conectar Dominio Shopify NetworkSolutions
opportunities.description: Mi dominio está registrado en Network Solutions y, al intentar enlazarlo con mi tienda Shopify, la plataforma marca “Los registros DNS son incorrectos”. El resultado es que el dominio no conecta en absoluto con la tienda. Busco a alguien que: • Revise y actualice los registros A y CNAME necesarios en Network Solutions para que coincidan con los valores oficiales de Shopify. • Verifique la propagación y compruebe que el certificado SSL quede activo sin advertencias. • Me entregue un breve informe con los pasos aplicados para que pueda mantener la configuración en el futuro. Proporciono acceso al panel de DNS de Network Solutions y a mi administrador de Shopify en modo colaborador. Necesito la solución cuanto antes para que la tienda quede accesible bajo el dominio principal.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40819896, publicado hace 22 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Portal Escorts con Perfiles Privados
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar un portal web para escorts donde cada perfil muestre fotos, descripción y datos de contacto, pero estos últimos solo se revelen a los visitantes que se registren. El registro debe ser muy sencillo: correo electrónico y contraseña, con confirmación por e-mail. Alcance principal • Listado de perfiles de escorts con galería fotográfica y sección de contacto. • Sistema de registro e inicio de sesión que valide el correo y oculte/ revele la información de contacto según el estado del usuario. • Panel de administración para que yo pueda crear, editar, activar o desactivar perfiles. • Diseño responsivo y amigable para móviles y escritorio. • Código bien organizado y documentado para facilitar futuras ampliaciones (por ejemplo, filtros de búsqueda o autogestión de perfiles). Entregables - Sitio funcional instalado en mi servidor de pruebas. - Base de datos configurada y archivo de respaldo. - Manual rápido de despliegue y uso del panel. - Acceso a repositorio o paquete completo del código fuente. Preferiría una solución en WordPress, Laravel u otro framework PHP que garantice rendimiento y seguridad, pero estoy abierto a recomendaciones siempre que el resultado cumpla con los puntos anteriores.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40819788, publicado hace 23 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Diseñador de Vestuario para Producciones Audiovisuales con Intelige...
opportunities.description: En Diseños del Arte llc (dda group) estamos desarrollando producciones audiovisuales innovadoras mediante inteligencia artificial y buscamos un profesional de diseño de vestuario altamente creativo y detallista para colaborar en la creación visual de nuestros personajes. Este rol es fundamental para construir personajes e historias auténticas desde cada detalle. Su participación se centrará en la definición completa del vestuario, calzado y accesorios para cada personaje. Será crucial considerar la época, el contexto cultural, la personalidad individual, la ocupación y las situaciones específicas de la historia para asegurar la coherencia y profundidad visual. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen: - Elaborar propuestas de vestuario detalladas por personaje, acompañadas de referencias visuales claras y concisas. - Realizar la selección de colores, telas, texturas, siluetas y accesorios que mejor se adapten a cada concepto. - Planificar los cambios de vestuario y establecer criterios de continuidad rigurosos, siguiendo el guion de las producciones. - Proporcionar indicaciones precisas y claras al artista visual encargado de generar las imágenes finales utilizando herramientas de inteligencia artificial. - Revisar meticulosamente las imágenes generadas para asegurar que el vestuario corresponda fielmente con la propuesta aprobada. Buscamos un profesional con sensibilidad narrativa, una atención excepcional al detalle y una probada capacidad para investigar y comunicar visualmente sus propuestas. Se valorará la experiencia previa en cine, televisión, teatro, publicidad o en proyectos de vestuario de época. Aunque la experiencia con herramientas de IA es un plus, no es un requisito indispensable. La colaboración se establece bajo la modalidad de servicios profesionales por proyecto y por entregables, con un alcance, honorarios, fechas y revisiones que serán acordados previamente. Estamos abiertos a considerar colaboradores que trabajen a distancia. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Diseño de moda ¿Qué necesitas?: Más de 10 prendas

opportunities.title: J.R. Enterprise
opportunities.description: Estoy consolidando J.R. Enterprise como firma de consultoría y asesoría empresarial enfocada en pequeñas y medianas empresas. Necesito un profesional que materialice tres documentos clave para arrancar operaciones: • Plan de Recursos Humanos - Diseño de la estructura organizacional (dirección general, asesor empresarial, auxiliar administrativo y encargado de marketing). - Descripción de funciones, responsabilidades y perfil ideal de cada puesto. - Estrategia de trabajo en equipo y canales de comunicación interna. - Propuesta de sueldos, prestaciones y programa inicial de capacitación. • Plan Económico-Financiero - Cálculo de la inversión inicial. - Identificación de gastos fijos y variables. - Proyección de ingresos mensuales y utilidades estimadas. - Costo por servicio, punto de equilibrio y análisis de rentabilidad. • Aspectos Legales - Guía paso a paso para registro ante el SAT y obtención de RFC. - Listado de obligaciones fiscales específicas. - Requisitos para formalizar la empresa, formato de contratos de prestación de servicios y aviso de privacidad. - Proceso de registro de marca ante el IMPI y cumplimiento de obligaciones laborales. Todos los documentos deben presentarse en formato editable (Word o Google Docs), con tablas y gráficos claros donde aplique, y referencias a las fuentes normativas mexicanas vigentes. Aprecio propuestas que incluyan ejemplos previos o plantillas similares desarrolladas para planes de negocio y estrategia.

opportunities.title: Reconstrucción PDF Escaneado Profesional
opportunities.description: Tengo un PDF de dos páginas que hoy luce claramente escaneado. Necesito transformarlo por completo para que aparente ser un documento digital original, listo para imprimir sin rastro de sombras, manchas ni pérdida de definición. Qué espero: • Reconstrucción visual total: corrige perspectiva, bordes y alineación, reescribe o limpia el texto para lograr nitidez absoluta y, si corresponde, vuelve a componer tablas, imágenes o sellos. • Resultado final en el mismo tamaño y resolución que el archivo fuente, entregado en PDF de alta calidad. • Preservación fiel de todo el contenido (texto, gráficos y estilos) con aspecto pulcro y profesional. Tu perfil ideal: – Dominio probado en retoque y restauración de documentos escaneados. – Experiencia demostrable realizando trabajos similares; muéstrame ejemplos concretos en tu propuesta. Entregables: 1. PDF final totalmente reconstruido y listo para impresión. 2. (Opcional) Archivo editable de apoyo si tu flujo de trabajo lo permite. Quedo atento a tu experiencia y a un breve resumen de cómo abordarías la reconstrucción de estas dos páginas.
